For the very important decision of the party, the revered Paramdharmadhish Uttaramnaya Jyotishpeethadhishwar Jagadguru Shankaracharya Swamishri: Avimukteshwarananda: Saraswati Maharaj '1008' accepted the request of the Sarvajan Sanatan Party and gave his consent.

All office bearers, workers and members of the party must accept the final decision on any organizational dispute within the Sarvajan Sanatan Party which will be presented before Shankaracharya Ji along with the party facts, Shankaracharya tradition is the power of Sanatan Culture, dignity and selflessness. Therefore, it will be the duty of everyone to accept the decision of Shankaracharya who is privileged even if he is not a member of the party. No one will have the right to remove Shankaracharya from this supreme position.

One member will be elected by the executive of all the provinces, he will work as a special member for the National Council and will play the role of guide in the provincial organization on behalf of the central leadership. But they will not have the right to directly appoint any member or expel them from the post and party.

Election of National President, National General Secretary and National Treasurer: The provincial president of all the provinces, provincial general secretary, provincial treasurer and one member each elected by the provincial executive (special member for the National Council) will be entitled to vote. That is, only four members from all the provinces will jointly conduct this election.
Sarvjan Sanatan Party will have a core committee of 108 members in which all its wings are also included.

This, the number of national office bearers of Sarvajan Sanatan Party is – 54 and other executive members are – 54. There will be 54 executive officers, 36 provincial guides-state in-charge, 09 wing heads and the remaining 09 other members of the executive.
